allowed_tools: Local Lean and Mathlib, supplied paper, and approved notes in retrieved production roles.

acceptance_tests.target-completeness: Deliver the entire selected labeled result as one or more proved Lean theorems.
acceptance_tests.construction-correctness: Define the upper-triangular computed Cholesky factor and its successful-completion semantics, including the rounded square root.
acceptance_tests.target-bound: Prove the symmetric perturbation identity and gamma(n+1) bound using the product of the entrywise absolute factors.
acceptance_tests.original-input-link: Connect the result to the actual construction and the original mathematical inputs.
acceptance_tests.assumption-integrity: Preserve the stated hypotheses and generality. Do not assume the conclusion or introduce a circular definition.

review_policy: Formal pass and agreement from both semantic evaluators. Expert verdict pending.
